parsed.rationale: All four members are `type-alias-object` declarations with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning the structural similarity is entirely in their alias shape rather than in any shared domain logic. `LargeNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, `MediumNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, `SmallNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, and `Header` are distinct widget view aliases that correspond to different WidgetKit presentation sizes and a header component — semantically unrelated roles whose coincidental structural identity (both have `shared_field_count: 2` and no differing slots) does not warrant merging. Collapsing them would destroy the per-size entry-view contract that WidgetKit requires and eliminate the meaningful naming distinction between small, medium, large, and header contexts. No context flags (`is_test`, `is_codegen`, `is_mock`, `is_sample_app`) are set, so the duplication is real but intentional by domain design.
